### Findings
Scope: Authorized products across all recorded history, filtered to completed items (`status = 'Complete'`) [q1]. Revenue reflects `SUM(sale_price)` on completed order items.

| brand | complete_revenue | complete_items |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| South | 140.0 | 7 |
| West | 210.0 | 7 |

- Both authorized brands recorded an identical volume of 7 completed items [q1].
- Brand "West" generated higher completed revenue (210.0) compared to brand "South" (140.0) [q1].

### Limitations
- Measures completed item revenue (`sale_price`); product costs, profit margins, and discounts relative to retail price were not queried [q1].
- Coverage across specific time windows or date ranges was not measured.
- Excludes canceled, returned, or pending item statuses.
- Order and unique customer grains were not evaluated.

### Action items (proposed)
- Evaluate product `retail_price` and `cost` against `sale_price` to examine margins and pricing variance by brand.
- Break down item volume and revenue by time periods (e.g., month or quarter) to assess sales trends.
- Query distinct order and customer counts to determine average units per order and customer concentration.
